ellie_dx: quick catch - in the node sample app retries we're seeing unredacted user emails in logs during auth retry flows. repro is small.
sam_platform: can you paste the log snippet and middleware order?
ellie_dx: log tail: ```
INFO start req_id=orig-42 user=redacted@example.com
DEBUG auth.attempt req_id=orig-42 attempt=2 status=401
INFO handler req_id=attempt-43 user=raw@leak.com action=proxy
```
ellie_dx: middleware order is `reqId -> otel -> redact -> authRetry -> handlers`.
raj_sre: sounds like redact runs before authRetry may mutate headers/ids. two approaches: move redact after retry OR perform redaction at emit time in the logger transport.
sam_platform: preference is emit-time redaction so we don't rely on middleware ordering. but keep original_req_id stable and add attempt_id for correlation.
ellie_dx: +1. also add SDK config `redactOnEmit` and a `preserveLegacyRedact` flag for customers who depend on old ordering.
raj_sre: I'll write a mocha test simulating 401->200 that asserts no raw emails appear and checks metrics `telemetry.unredacted_email_count==0`.
sam_platform: implemented quick change: logger now runs `onBeforeSend(entry) { scrub(entry.context) }` and we include `orig_req_id` and `attempt_id` in structured logs. verified locally under retry stress.
ellie_dx: nice. any concerns about performance for deep JSON traversal?
sam_platform: added a configurable scrub depth with sane default; also async scrub in transport to avoid blocking main flow.
ci-bot: CI started for branch feat/emit-redact (build #9919).
ci-bot: unit tests passed (18s).
ellie_dx: PR up with tests, config flags, and README update recommending `orig_req_id` + `attempt_id` in formats.
raj_sre: will review and add e2e canary check.
ellie_dx: thanks - will watch the canary metric for 90m after deploy. :eyes:
